input.command: $procs = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process; $procs | Where-Object { $_.Name -match 'vs_|setup|installer|vswhere|bootstrapper|winget|msiexec' -or $_.CommandLine -match 'Visual Studio|vs_buildtools|vs_installer' } | ForEach-Object { $p=$_; $chain=@(); $cur=$p; for ($i=0; $i -lt 8 -and $cur; $i++) { $par = $procs | Where-Object ProcessId -eq $cur.ParentProcessId; if (-not $par) { $chain += "[$($cur.ParentProcessId) gone]"; break }; $chain += "$($par.ProcessId) $($par.Name)"; $cur=$par }; "PID $($p.ProcessId) $($p.Name) started $($p.CreationDate)`n  cmd: $(if ($p.CommandLine) { $p.CommandLine.Substring(0,[math]::Min(250,$p.CommandLine.Length)) })`n  parents: $($chain -join ' <- ')" }
input.description: Find the Visual Studio installer and its parent process chain
